Let's get this farce started. I'm here to defend the utterly reasonable stance that we need to regulate our way out of this gun culture chaos. I mean, come on, we're the only developed country with more guns than people, and we're still surprised when we have mass shootings? It's like, what's next, expecting people to drive safely without seatbelts?

Look, I'm not here to take away your precious Bibles or your hunting rifles. I just want us to acknowledge that the Second Amendment was written in a very different time, and it's time to adapt. We need to be realistic about the damage these guns are causing and take steps to mitigate it. That's all. Don't @ me.

Now, I'm sure my opponent will come at me with the usual talking points about individual freedom and how the government's going to take away your rights. But let's be real, if you're that worried about your rights, maybe you shouldn't be packing a heat. Priorities, people!

Let's get this over with, shall we?
